summary: Diff adds customer-side ReportIssueDialog integration on MyBookingsPage, extends admin NotificationPanel with an "issues" category and additional storage/event listeners, and updates BookingManagement with an isExpired() helper and continued inclusion of all bookings. However, key acceptance-criteria elements (issue notification creation + issue-specific styling, and expired visual treatment) are not fully evidenced in the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Submitting an issue adds a permanent admin notification with category "issues" (via existing addPermanentNotification usage).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows MyBookingsPage importing ReportIssueDialog and NotificationPanel adding an 'issues' category, but there is no visible code showing the customer issue submission path calling addPermanentNotification with category 'issues'.

missing_requirements.requirement: In the admin NotificationPanel, issue notifications are grouped under the "issues" category and are visually distinct from other categories (e.g., red icon/badge/left accent bar).
missing_requirements.reason: NotificationPanel defines 'issues' in the category union and openCategories, but the diff is truncated before showing category rendering/styling (icons/badges/accent), so distinct visual treatment for 'issues' is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Expired bookings are visually differentiated (e.g., muted/grey styling and/or an "Expired" badge) while keeping existing status badges intact, applied consistently to every expired booking.
missing_requirements.reason: BookingManagement adds an isExpired() helper and computes 'expired' per booking, but the diff is truncated before any conditional classNames/badges are shown, so the required expired visual treatment is not evidenced.
